## Modular & Scalable GTM API

Everything you need to build reliable data pipelines - from flexible architecture to dedicated developer support

Unified data schema

One clean, consistent data format for all your contacts and target accounts. No more field mapping headaches or schema changes.

High rate limits

Unlike typical waterfall enrichment vendors who struggle with rate limits, we handle high volumes seamlessly - whether you need 100 or 1,000 requests per minute.

99.99% uptime

True 99.99% uptime with built-in redundancy. With 30+ data vendors, we keep running even if multiple providers go down.

Dedicated onboarding

Direct access to our engineering team via Slack. Get implementation help, custom solutions, and <1hr response times from the people who built it.

Transparent pricing

Usage-based pricing with no surprises. Pay for what you use, scale as you grow, no hidden fees.

Quick start

# Create an API Key (Sub-key)

## Prerequisites

  * Ability to manage API keys for the account (requires a master API key per the docs)

## Method

`POST`

## URL

`https://api.waterfall.io/v1/api-keys`

## Description

Creates a new API key (sub-key) for the account. You can optionally set a per-interval request limit for the new key; if omitted, the current implementation defaults to 50.

## Enforcement Rules

  * When executing the action, ensure to send Path Parameters in the URL and not in the body. (This endpoint has no path parameters.)
  * When executing the action, ensure to send Query Parameters in the URL as query parameters and not in the body. (This endpoint has no query parameters.)
  * Request body is required and must be JSON.
  * `notes` is required.
  * `per_interval` is optional; if omitted, the current implementation defaults to `50`.
  * `per_interval` must be `>= 1`.

# Pay for answers, not for lookups

Outcome-based across every endpoint: a credit is deducted when we return a verified result, never once per vendor we queried to find it

The model

## Three rules that decide what you pay

Image

A miss costs nothing

Billing

We are charged by our vendors on every request we make on your behalf, including the ones that come back empty. You are not. A credit is deducted only when we hand back a verified result, so the risk of a low-coverage file sits with us rather than with your budget.

Image

One credit covers the whole waterfall

Coverage

A single request may pass through several of our 30+ sources before one returns a verified answer. You are charged once, for the answer. This is the structural difference from buying vendors directly, where each contract you add multiplies your cost per record whether or not that vendor was the one that found it.

Rates are quoted against your data

Commercials

Per-credit rates depend on the endpoints you use and the volume you commit to. We quote after running a benchmark on a sample of your own records, because a list price set against someone else's file tells you nothing about what your file will cost.

Image

Why there is no public rate card

Straight answer

Because a per-record price is not comparable across vendors and we would rather not pretend otherwise. Two providers quoting the same cent-per-email can differ by a factor of three on what fraction of your file they actually resolve, and the cheaper one is usually the more expensive one once you divide by results. The number that matters is your cost per verified result on your records, and the only honest way to produce it is to run both against the same file. We will do that before quoting, and we will show you the working.
